canonical_project: Government existing national data center / INIC data center
owner: Government of Sao Tome and Principe / Instituto de Inovacao e Conhecimento (INIC)
notes: World Bank Digital Sao Tome and Principe implementation mission noted an existing government data center assessed by INIC's data-center technical-assistance consultant, with options to rehabilitate current facilities or build a new Tier III site. Exact district is not stated; assigned to Agua Grande because national government/INIC functions are concentrated in Sao Tome city.
